part.text:
Done. Incremental builds and caching implemented without breaking existing functionality.

**What was added:**
- `src/cache.ts` — `BuildCache` orchestrator + SHA-256 hashing, `.ssg-cache.json` manifest load/save (cached parsed frontmatter, rendered HTML, source/template hashes, render times), and invalidate-on-change logic.
- `src/plugins/markdown.ts` — skips re-parsing unchanged pages (reuses cached frontmatter); records fresh parses.
- `src/plugins/templates.ts` — skips re-rendering cached pages, reuses cached index.html, otherwise renders and records outputs.
- `src/engine.ts` — creates the cache, writes/removes stale outputs, saves the manifest, reports `BuildStats` via `onStats`.
- `src/cli.ts` — `--incremental` and `--clean` flags + build stats output (`built/skipped/saved ms`).
- `src/types.ts` / `src/ssg.ts` — new optional `Page.sourceFile`, `BuildStats`, and `BuildOptions.incremental/clean/cacheFile/onStats`; cache helpers exported.
- `tests/incremental.test.ts` — 17 tests covering: first-run full build + manifest, unchanged-build full skip, cached frontmatter reuse, single-source change, template-change invalidation, new pages, deleted pages (stale output removed), missing output on disk, `--clean`, missing/corrupt cache, non-incremental no-manifest, stats reporting, custom cache path, and fixture templates.

`typecheck` (tsc --noEmit) is clean; CLI smoke test confirmed `1 built/0 skipped` then `0 built/1 skipped, saved 9ms`.
